models.author: Alpha Romer Coma
models.description:
Gemma 3 4B-IT fine-tuned via a two-stage RLHF pipeline on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090.

**Stage 1 — SFT:** LoRA (r=32, alpha=64) on 20K samples from HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k. 1 epoch, effective batch size 8, lr=2e-4, cosine schedule, bfloat16.

**Stage 2 — DPO:** LoRA (r=16, alpha=32) on quality-filtered argilla/distilabel-intel-orca-dpo-pairs (score≥8, no ties, no GSM8K overlap). 1 epoch, effective batch size 8, lr=5e-5, beta=0.1, sigmoid loss.

This is the fully merged model (not a LoRA adapter). Load directly with transformers as Gemma3ForCausalLM.

instances.overview: Fully merged Gemma3ForCausalLM weights (SFT + DPO). Load directly with AutoModelForCausalLM — no adapter needed.

models.subtitle: Two-stage fine-tuned: SFT on ultrachat_200k, DPO on intel-orca-dpo-pairs
